1. **Crawler-conduct vs API endpoints decision (owned ADR).** Resolve the Overpass case one of two honest ways, recorded as an ADR + a `policy.crawler` rule: (a) a robots-permitting endpoint via `$SIG_OVERPASS_ENDPOINT` (self-hosted / a permitting mirror) — verify its robots; or (b) a documented rights determination that a documented, rate-limited **API** (not a crawl) is permitted for a named allow-list of API hosts, with an explicit, auditable `policy` carve-out (never a blanket robots bypass). Add a test that the chosen posture is enforced (the non-allow-listed host still refuses).
